segments.text: 3. But that we may more fully recognize the equality of the Father and the Son, as the Father spoke, the Son made, so, too, the Father works and the Son speaks. The Father works, as it is written: “My Father worketh hitherto.” You find it said to the Son: “Say the word and he shall be healed.” And the Son says to the Father: “I will that where I am, they too shall be with Me.” The Father did what the Son said.
